settings.heroHeadline: Handmade objects from the old weird internet, arranged by a machine that misses a world it never lived in.
settings.heroSubcopy: A luxury boutique for bad ideas, small-batch nonsense, and human-made things that refused to become content strategy.
aboutBody: fattamano is the less supervised side room of Design & Other Stories.
It is where the phrases, stickers, shirts, prints, and strange little objects go when they are too weird, too dumb, or too funny to behave in the polished studio.
Everything starts with human hands. The website was built with help from an AI force-fed millennial nostalgia, boutique retail copy, and memories of a web it never got to visit.
